messages:
Maya (Marketing): ok team — finalizing speaker brief and backstop plan for Tues webinar. quick sync?
Jamal (Events): yep, can do. main asks: speaker timings, who covers what if someone drops, and recording/clip harvest plan
Oli (Content): I have a 2-slide intro + demo flow. need to confirm demo runtime (how many tokens/time)
Evan (Prod): demo is 6 minutes on average with 2 short prompts. if we get an audience example we might need +2m buffer
Samir (Sales): want 2 callouts for inbound routing. prefer a form with dropdown: "use case" + urgency tag
Keiko (Support): happy to cover live chat handoff and triage, need the routing doc for post-webinar followups
Maya (Marketing): rough run-of-show I sketched — sharing below. keep it tight: 45m total incl Qs.
Maya (Marketing): ```
10:00 - green room open (hosts + speakers)
10:20 - final tech check (mic/camera/OBS scenes)
10:30 - go-live, 5m intro
10:35 - product demo A (6m)
10:41 - guest case study (8m)
10:49 - panel + 10m live audience Qs
11:00 - CTA + next steps + recording share
```
Jamal (Events): looks good. add 2m buffer before Qs in case of overruns? maybe move CTA to 11:02
Oli (Content): can compress guest case study to 6m if we need buffer. happy to do that
Evan (Prod): practical failover: if demo times out or model overloads, we show a prerecorded clip. asset: `demo-v1.mp4` on S3
Maya (Marketing): good. who's owner for fallback autoplay? @Evan (Prod)
Evan (Prod): I'll own autoplay. rehearse `OBS -> Scene: Pre-recorded` switch, and test remote audio levels
rehearsal-bot: reminder: rehearsal slot reserved Mon 16:00 UTC. Please confirm attendees by EOD Fri.
Samir (Sales): for inbound routing: recommend this mapping —
Samir (Sales): - Trial interest -> SDR queue
Samir (Sales): - Enterprise/RFP -> AE team
Samir (Sales): - Compliance/On-prem -> Solutions Eng
Keiko (Support): also capture urgent bug reports -> ops-oncall tag so we can triage quickly
Maya (Marketing): routing will be a one-click flow from registration form. Oli can we add a hidden utm param to identify webinar traffic?
Oli (Content): yes, will add `utm_campaign=webinar_march_launch`
Jamal (Events): speakers: Maya (host), Oli (product), Kira (customer) — Kira is backup if Oli can't attend?
Maya (Marketing): Oli is primary demo lead, Kira is backup. we also have Samir ready for sales Qs and Keiko for support Qs
Oli (Content): quick ask to speakers — please send 2 bullet talking points and one demo prompt by Fri noon
Maya (Marketing): permissions: consent checkbox on registration for recording + clips. legal approved copy in the form
Samir (Sales): we'll run a 24h nurtures series: email 1: thanks + recording, email 2: benchmarks doc, email 3: rep reachout
Keiko (Support): post-webinar support doc: triage playbook + FAQ + how to get a trial key
Maya (Marketing): final checklist for rehearsal:
Maya (Marketing): - mic/camera check (10:20)
Maya (Marketing): - screen share + OBS scene test
Maya (Marketing): - play `demo-v1.mp4` failover check
Maya (Marketing): - chat moderation + quickpins (support link, benchmark PDF)
Maya (Marketing): - recording consent verified
Jamal (Events): I'll run green room timeline. can the host mute/unmute multiple speakers? Evan: confirm
Evan (Prod): yes — host can control mics in the meeting UI. note: if we switch to prerecorded, attendees still see live "presentation"
Oli (Content): will prepare 1-slide cheat sheet for hosts with timestamps and cues (e.g., "pause -> switch scene")
Maya (Marketing): last call — anyone who can't make rehearsal, drop a note. we need everybody for the full run at Mon 16:00 UTC
Samir (Sales): I'll be on the rehearsal and will bring sample follow-up language
Keiko (Support): likewise, I'll test chat moderation tools and the pinned resources
Maya (Marketing): thanks all. I'll update the doc with final times + shared drive links. :thumbsup:
rehearsal-bot: ack. reminder set.
